_comment: Nebraska's Legislature is officially nonpartisan on the ballot, so Open States reports every senator's party as 'Nonpartisan' — not useful for map coloring. This overrides that with each senator's actual known party/caucus affiliation, sourced from Wikipedia's Nebraska Legislature members table + Ballotpedia cross-checks (research agent, 2026-08-25). Verified against the reported 33R-15D-1I composition (matches exactly).
